title: Refuse a too-old Git in the test launcher with a typed message instead of building a run directory from echoed option text
outcome: Refuse a too-old Git in the test launcher with a typed message instead of building a run directory from echoed option text
acceptance: When `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path review-runs` returns output that is not an absolute path (as Git older than 2.31 does by echoing the option), scripts/test-launcher.mjs refuses before creating any run directory, with a typed message naming the minimum Git version and the resolved git executable path
A launcher test covers the refusal with a fake git that echoes the option text
No support for old Git is added; the review-freeze script's use of the same flag is checked and given the same refusal if it shares the failure mode
